summary: WARDOGS is a tactical all-out warfare FPS by BULKHEAD, published by Team17. Up to 100 players across three teams fight for Control Zones on large destructible maps. Cash and XP progression reward teamplay; loadouts and vehicles are purchased each life.
coreMechanics: Up to 100 players split across three teams
Randomized Control Zones approximately 2x2 km inside larger maps
First team to 100 Control Zone points wins
Every player starts with $10,000; cash persists between matches
Custom loadouts purchased each life (weapons, gear, utility, vehicles)
FOB building, destruction, vehicles including helicopters and artillery

facts.statement: Minimum: Windows 10, i5-8600 / Ryzen 5 3500, 16 GB RAM, GTX 1660 / RX 590, 50 GB storage.
Recommended: Windows 11, i7-12700k / Ryzen 7 5700x, 16 GB RAM, RTX 3070 / RX 6700 XT, 50 GB storage.
Community map tools commonly list Bakurani, Ozeti and Zestafona as Early Access maps.
